actor.description: Agent, role, system, object, process, or implied operator to whom the norm applies.

polarity.description: Directive valence. Polarity is required for bridging prohibitions to non-collapse structure.

action.description: The directed operation, treatment, preservation, separation, or practice.

object.description: Primary object acted on or governed.

comparison_or_target.description: Target, contrast class, forbidden collapse partner, or comparison basis.

scope.description: Envelope in which the norm applies.

rationale.description: Reason, consequence basis, provenance basis, or justification. May be elided.

source_form.description: Surface form that produced the candidate.

omitted_fields.description: Fields not present in the source surface.
